name: Navigation — header links navigate to correct pages

planSteps.description: The navigation bar contains links for 'المميزات' or 'Features', 'الأسعار' or 'Pricing', 'المدونة' or 'Blog', and 'تسجيل الدخول' or 'Login'
Click the link containing 'المميزات' or 'Features' in the navigation
The URL changes to /features and the features page heading is visible
Navigate back to / and click the 'الأسعار' or 'Pricing' link
The URL changes to /pricing and pricing content is visible
